notes.title: Dream Flash Early Access 24.5 Out Now
notes.notes:

Hello everyone, a new update has been released with 2 new bosses, 2 new weapons, and several performance improvements.

[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1D2zl34RnSllWvmYsguN3Yezk0s88p4OE9gqZZdsYzZM/edit?usp=sharing]Full Changelog[/url]

notes.title: Dream Flash Early Access 23 Out now
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34983150/42683ef96643d78eb23b19e01109d3cd9d355fc4.png[/img]

Dream Flash Early Access 23 is out now! This update includes 3 new bosses, 2 renovated transformations, and some new items. There was also a lot of polish done behind the scenes.

[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1D2zl34RnSllWvmYsguN3Yezk0s88p4OE9gqZZdsYzZM/edit?usp=sharing]List of Changes[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34983150/45c4dac750feebf4d90f921375a8a5ee7149a663.png[/img]

I was originally going to release 22.5 at the end of march, but all of the back end stuff I needed to do to improve the code for future updates and synergies was taking longer than I thought it would. So I just decided to skip releasing that and wait longer between updates so that there can also be a decent amount of new features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34983150/a70f4378519705120a74ff02cc2d53d830de1dba.png[/img]

The rest of the updates this year shouldn't require any significant back end changes thankfully so expect the regularly planned schedule of a new major version every 2 months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34983150/4baf82b8949d08c810ab2b36bfdb57840ae5c44c.png[/img]

Ok that is technically a lie. I am planning on releasing a 23.5 by the end of June before starting v24. 23.5 will allegedly have another new boss, plus a bunch of requested QoL stuff like updated and better tutorials. I might also try adding controller support finally since I have a good excuse. More on that later maybe.

Anyways thanks for playing the game!

notes.title: Dream Flash Early Access 21.5 Out Now
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34983150/3c8eeb762006ea9735da4fa9e2165ccf115c2e76.png[/img]

Dream Flash Early Access 21.5 is out now! This update comes with a large amount of quality of life changes in addition to a new/updated boss.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34983150/eedd9622f686ee399c8b5de2712ab685ccfe74f5.png[/img]

[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1D2zl34RnSllWvmYsguN3Yezk0s88p4OE9gqZZdsYzZM/edit?usp=sharing]Full Changelog[/url]

One other noteworthy thing is that almost every negative emotion pool item has been buffed. For the most part this means that their positive benefit has been doubled in effectiveness.

Ideally every item in the game should be noticeably impactful to the run, whether that be in a purely positive way, or in a negative way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34983150/96a5995794d44635aaaa08db472641ccd51c2d75.png[/img]

Hey everyone, DF early access update 18.1 is out now. This is a small polish update that adds QoL stuff like performance optimization and some other things.

List of Changes:
[list]
[*] New Settings for low graphics mode, turning off screenshake, and turning off particle effects
[*] New Recollection Index Visuals
[*] New Item thought cloud visuals
[*] New Pause menu visuals
[*] Bullets will lag less now, particles as well

notes.title: Dream Flash Demo 18 Out Now
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34983150/45be0c1014af08b1c5105b7a47b77d87587855ea.png[/img]

Dream Flash Demo 18 is finally out! This is a huge update that adds 58 new items, heavily changes up game mechanics, and adds a bunch of visual renovations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34983150/ae8dd3d16dee484b89835339d34a4cfc75fdf30a.png[/img]

The main change in this update is that spiritual stats each have their own item pool now. These items could either enhance or devastate your run so you'll need to think carefully about what you pick.

[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1D2zl34RnSllWvmYsguN3Yezk0s88p4OE9gqZZdsYzZM/edit?usp=sharing]Demo 18 List of Changes[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34983150/86f912f8824e24fc413097f0ed3ecb8c2b8d57d4.png[/img]

There was also a demo 17.5 update that added new art work and improved attacks to the masked spirits. I probably should have announced that when it came out since I didn't think demo 18 would take this long. But anyways those 17.5 changes were planned to be in demo 18 so think of it as one big mega update. 

I'd say Dream Flash is now about 70-80% maybe. The two updates (18.5/19) will be mainly polish and visual renovation. Once those are out I will no longer be updating the early access version of the game and will instead be working on the full release update. I have no idea how long this will take but it is probably going to be a long time as I plan on adding a large chunk of content to the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34983150/6ad3d541f5b1fc2ed0a334f7b1e1ceade791e77d.png[/img]

Hope you enjoy this update and any upcoming updates!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1D2zl34RnSllWvmYsguN3Yezk0s88p4OE9gqZZdsYzZM/edit?usp=sharing]Change-log for Demo 17 and previous updates[/url]

The next two updates should come out in a timely manner since they are already planned out and I've managed to simplify my workflow to be much more efficient.

notes.title: Dream Flash Overall Development Update/Info Dump
notes.notes:
Yo its ramaf. It’s been more than a year and a half since Dream Flash entered early access on steam, and more than two years since I started working on Dream Flash. It's been a long journey so far and the game has come a long way. It’s insane looking at footage from demo 1 of the game and comparing that to how it looks now. However, we still have a long way to go before I am done with all of the planned content and am truly satisfied with DF. I’d say that we have only recently passed the 50% completion mark.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34983150/67f4d0999ffdb22e1d3e8c059aeb88e7521ecac4.png[/img]

	This may seem like a low percentage for two years of work, but this game has a massive amount of content already and has a massive amount of content planned. In addition to this I’ve been working on getting a degree while also working on this game and other side projects. Other things in life have been eating up dev time and I cannot say that dev will be going much faster from here on out. I will however say that development will continue to be consistent and that the game will continue to get better and better over time. All of the coolest planned features have yet to be added.

	I am quite satisfied with the progress that the game has made in 2020. I managed to remake all of the art myself, and have successfully animated and redesigned all 54 bosses that are currently in the game. In 2021 I plan on focusing primarily on new content so look forward to that. In order to speed up development on the game I’ve been reassessing what's necessary and what isn’t. I’m gonna try to lean more into the idea of working smarter instead of harder, while still working hard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34983150/55bb59bfd28d0308f50ea3840b7a477bb8a69af4.png[/img]

Game Content so Far:

- 54 Bosses out of 100+
- 85 Weapons out of 120+
- 175 Items out of 300+
- 3 out of 4+ Stages
- All of the core gameplay features, except for a secret one coming soon

I’ve revised the weapon goal from being over 150 to being only 120. The reasoning for this is that many weapons in the game felt like they were just slightly different copies of other existing weapons, so I’ve actually removed/combined about a dozen weapons from the game already. I’d rather focus on making less weapons that are more fleshed out and cooler than simply adding a large number of them. I also realized that less weapons are necessary than I had originally planned because planned future features will give the soul much more variety in its build.

For the immediate future I’m planning on fixing/adding a bunch of features that I’ve been neglecting. Stuff like real sound effects, a control menu, better UI, and overall improvements to game mechanics to make the game really feel like an actual presentable game. After that I’m gonna spend most of the dev time on just adding as many bosses as possible while also working on implementing a massive feature that has been held secret. It will completely change how you play the game.

Thanks for playing Dream Flash, I hope you look forward to everything I have planned for it.

notes.title: Dream Flash Demo 8.1 Out Now!
notes.notes:
Dream Flash has now been on Steam Early Access for about 5 days. I've been working on fixing bugs and tuning the game to make it feel as good as possible. Thank you to everyone who has bought the game and who is playing the game. As of right now I am planning out demo 09 content. I am planning on demo 09 being a big one so look forward to that. With demo 8.1 I focused on adding changes that would improve the flow of the game and fix some issues:

Demo 08.1 Changelog:

[list]
[*] Increased Shot Speed for most weapons 
[*] Increased Fire Rate for several weapons
[*] Increased Damage for some weapons
[*] Flash Boss Bullet Damage Modified (6 -> 7.5)
[*] Feel Boss Bullet Damage Modified (7 -> 8)
[*] Dream Boss Bullet Damage Modified (8 -> 8.5)
[*] Nightmare Boss Bullet Damage Modified (9 -> 9)
[*] Shop Weapon Cost (25 -> 30)
[*] Shop Misc Item Cost (25 -> 30)
[*] Shop Stat/Food Cost (20 -> 25)
[*] Lesser Heart Shop Cost (20 -> 15)
[*] Creative Spam: -1 Essence Cost -> -2 Essence Cost +10 Max Essence
[*] Fixed Boss Difficulty being too high from loathing and despair
[*] Fixed Thought Figments being unable to die from contact damage
[*] Improved Thought Figment boss collisions
[/list]

Also for information on previous version history: 

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1D2zl34RnSllWvmYsguN3Yezk0s88p4OE9gqZZdsYzZM/edit?usp=sharing

Demo 09 is planned to be done by the end of June. As always you can get updates on game dev by following ramafparty on twitter, or joining the ramafparty discord!
